mapper.select: SELECT booth_item_id, booth_id, name, type, image_url, note FROM booth_item WHERE booth_id = #{boothId} ORDER BY booth_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booth (application_id, business_id, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{businessId}, #{confirmedAt})
INSERT INTO booth_item (booth_id, name, type, image_url, note) VALUES (#{boothId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{imageUrl}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fairs WHERE fair_id = #{fairId})

SELECT bt.booth_id AS boothId, biz.name AS businessName, bs.slot_number AS slotNumber, bs.pos_x AS posX, bs.pos_y AS posY, bs.width AS width, bs.height AS height, h.hall_id AS hallId, h.name AS hallName, h.floor_plan_image_url AS floorPlanImageUrl FROM booth bt JOIN business biz ON biz.business_id = bt.business_id JOIN application_slot aps ON aps.application_id = bt.application_id JOIN booth_slots bs ON bs.booth_slot_id = aps.booth_slot_id JOIN halls h ON h.hall_id = bs.hall_id WHERE h.fair_id = #{fairId} ORDER BY bs.slot_number
